title: Why would you change your premium fees unannounced?
body: Been using the app for quite some time already then I finally decided to upgrade to premium this month. Just today, I’ve been notified that I don’t have the premium version anymore and would have to pay a lot more. They changed from one-time fee to monthly subscription for the premium. This has been a nice app that wasn’t overpriced. But because of this, I’ll be deleting this scam of an app and wish them good luck with their disgruntled users.

author: Asdgshjsbxjsj

title: Since when did this app become so expensive?
body: I downloaded this last year and loved it because it did the job and it’s price for Premium was affordable (like $3). It wasn’t detailed and all that like other habit trackers, but I didn’t need that... and then I see now that I have to pay like US$40 annually to access their Premium features??? No way. The developers went way off what it was meant to be and now I’m deleting the app.
author: claraquesi95

title: Promised One time Fee but now charging subscription!
body:
In the beginning I liked the app because of their one time fee forever “promise”. When I used it this morning it told me that I need to have a monthly subscription! Deceptive app! You need a premium
Sub to use dark mode?!? I’m deleting the app and using habit tracker instead. Please don’t fall for the false promises by this app!
author: Kristovksy

title: So disappointing.
body:
I have been using this app consistently for a few years and have been happy about it simple yet effective features. The UI is great and easy to use. I even upgraded to Premium because I loved it so much and it was a one-time purchase. However, upon checking the app this afternoon, I am suddenly downgraded to the basic version and encouraged to buy the premium version for a monthly fee.

I am terribly disappointed at the lack of notice and sudden excessive charges. This app has been effective but you would think once you paid for it that you'd be able to keep the premium version.
author: maigavs

title: Amazing!!
body: I have been using this for the past month and it’s AMAZING! It keeps me motivated and you can add as many habits as you want!! Unlike other apps i tried this one is the winner 🏆🏆🏆
author: weirdo-me-he

title: Simple and keeps my habits in check
body: I’ve been using it for months and I love it! I just want to suggest more color options and be able to sort my habits into certain categories. I have different habits-to-check on different life areas such as health and fitness, career and mental clarity. Hope this gets to the team!
author: Jara R.

title: Excellent app!
body:
I’ve been looking for a habit tracking app for a while now. I found this last August, and immediately used it — clean UI with straightforward functionalities for me. Great job for the developers! Especially that it is free, has NO ADS, and has an optional one-time payment. I already have 4 habits on it. Paying premium once I save up for it. :)

As a user, may I suggest a few features:
1) a habit be done/tracked multiple times in a day
2) the backup be possible with Google

Overall, excellent app by the developers.
author: rltgvr

title: Habit for iPad, please!
body: The app is definitely neat and minimalistic; it doesn’t feel overwhelming to use! I would love for this app to have full integration and support for the iPad, because it only shows as an iPhone app on the tablet. Kudos to the makers! Will upgrade soon!
author: ceadlyn

title: Great but something’s missing
body: It would be nice if there was more customization in terms of when we would be doing the habit/ when we would like to be reminded for example I put in a habit of wanting to exercise 3x a week but in the reminder I could only choose the time but not the days when I wanted to be reminded of exercising. Also it would also be nice if we could make a habit something we could do more than once a day like I wanted to have a habit of doing my skincare twice a day but currently that’s not possible. Great app though! Just a few minor tweaks would be nice :)
author: Kristine Relampagos

title: Download this great app
body: Stop looking around for another habit tracking app, this is the one you need. This app is so simple, so easy to understand and very straight forward. What’s really great about this app is that you decide how much you are willing to pay for it based on how much you like the experience.

title: Best app for tracking
body: The style is aesthetically pleasing and minimalistic. Best value as it is free and does not limit you much. Highly recommended. Will upgrade to support the devs!

title: Cute and won’t make you pay a lot.
body: It’s amazing that unlike the previous habit tracker I used, I can add as many habits as I like (or so I could say for now because I haven’t gone beyond 10 yet) without going premium. I did check the premium options and it literally raised my eyebrows seeing that all the options are one-time payments and not monthly subscriptions! Also, the app looks so cute and I don’t need to choose the colors coz they’re all nice. ❤️ Thank you for developing this app!

title: Toni

author: Franie1995

title: I appreciate this app
body: A lot of habit trackers are overpriced and I feel bad about those apps. Some of them are even making two versions of the same app to make money out of it. I get that. As a creator of course we want to make money out of it but the function pf a tracker is not really high maintenance and it doesn't require huge cloud space. So why charge monthly with a price of an all in one app. I love this app because it is simplified and not overpriced.. I haven't paid the premium but I'll definitely do once I can. You have an option to pay for the premium for the desired price. It's like a token of appreciation to the developers. It's also one time purchase. I'll definitely recommend this on my blog to give support to the developer because they are awesome!

title: don’t want to make developers sad
body:
i have been loyal to one habit tracker app for almost three years. i always thought there was something missing about it but i kept using it as it served its purpose and it was the best app out there for me. BUT THIS ONE!!!! this app finally made me delete it as i found a better one. I love how Habit does not have so many distractions unlike other habit tracker apps. It’s simple and easy to use, but not so easy that it makes it boring. I love the colors, and basically everything. PLUS IT’S FREE! A super cute and FREE app? I mean....
I’m hoping for more great updates in the future!
(i hope i cheered the developers with this)
